sprint.name: Sprint 24: Real-time Collaboration & Auth
sprint.goal: Deliver hardened enterprise auth flow, real-time board sync, and burndown analytics dashboard.

tasks.title: Implement in-memory Axios 401 token refresh queue
tasks.description: Ensure concurrent requests hitting 401 are held in a Promise queue while a single refresh token request resolves with DummyJSON auth endpoint.

comments.content: Ensure we reject the queue if the refresh token call returns 401 or invalid session.

tasks.title: Build @dnd-kit Kanban Board with collision detection
tasks.description: Construct 4-column drag and drop sprint board utilizing Pointer and Keyboard sensors, rectIntersection collision, and optimistic Zustand store mutations.

comments.content: Added drag handle indicator icon to cards to make draggable intent explicit on mobile.

tasks.title: Build Recharts Sprint Burndown & Status visualizations
tasks.description: Connect Zustand board state directly to Recharts responsive containers for live burndown, status distribution, priority bars, and team workload.

tasks.title: Custom Design System: Accessible Dropdown and Portaled Modal
tasks.description: Engineer accessible Select component with full keyboard navigation (ArrowUp/Down, Enter, Escape) and Modal/Drawer with focus trap and backdrop.

comments.content: Tested ARIA roles role='listbox' and role='option'. Works smoothly with Screen Readers.

tasks.title: Real-time JSONPlaceholder Notification Poller & Diff Engine
tasks.description: TanStack Query polling hook with refetchInterval that diffs incoming IDs with existing store IDs, firing toasts and updating unread badges.

tasks.title: End-to-end Vitest Test Suite for Stores & Interceptors
tasks.description: Write isolated tests for useToast lifecycle, Zustand board store task transitions/CRUD, and Axios 401 interception retry flow.

tasks.title: Database indexing for Sprint Audit History logs
tasks.description: Optimize composite indices on sprint_id and updated_at for fast query performance in retrospective reports.

tasks.title: Implement Dark / Light mode CSS variables and persistence
tasks.description: Configure Tailwind darkMode 'class' strategy with local storage persistence and instant toggle transition.

tasks.title: Automated Webhooks Integration for Slack Sprint Summaries
tasks.description: Allow team leads to configure webhook URLs to post daily burndown status updates and completed tickets.

tasks.title: Side Drawer Portal with Slide-in Transition
tasks.description: Slide-out panel rendered in portal-root providing deep task metadata editing, comments conversation, and delete action.

tasks.title: Sprint Velocity Calculation & Estimations Engine
tasks.description: Compute team velocity over previous 3 sprints to recommend ideal story point capacity for upcoming iterations.

tasks.title: Mobile Responsive Navigation & Bottom Action Bar
tasks.description: Provide collapsible responsive sidebar for desktop and mobile drawer navigation with quick task creation.
